title: Linearity
summary: A linear map preserves addition and scalar multiplication.

context.note: This node belongs to one explicit foundational presentation; alternate foundations may encode it differently.

assumptions.text: The declared vector spaces context is fixed.

content.plain: A linear map preserves addition and scalar multiplication.
content.exact: T:V→W is linear iff T(av+bw)=aT(v)+bT(w) for all vectors v,w and scalars a,b.
content.example: Differentiation is linear on suitable function spaces.
content.caveat: Linear behavior is relative to chosen vector-space structures.
